input.summary: Add a Customer termination-for-convenience right (30 days' notice, pro-rata refund) as new Section 9.4.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement runs three years with 12-month renewals but gives us no right to exit without cause, so we have added a 30 days' notice convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, consistent with our standard position. If you prefer, we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty, early-termination fee, or other charge, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
